description: This file defines a static utility class for handling Azure Table Storage operations related to stream failure handling in an Orleans streaming application. It provides methods to retrieve failure counts and delete the relevant table, using configuration options and external Azure SDK components.

methods.name: DeleteAll
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the entire table used for tracking stream failures.

methods.name: GetDataManager
methods.description: Creates and configures an AzureTableDataManager instance based on the current configuration settings, handling authentication and connection details.
